# Ana Šercer

> Freelance digital marketer based in Ljubljana, Slovenia, with 8+ years of experience. Helps small businesses with part-time marketing (from €750/month), GEO optimisation for ChatGPT and AI search, SEO, social media, Meta ads and websites. Works in Slovenian, English and Spanish.

## Services
- [Part-time marketer (from €750/month)](https://anasercer.com/collaboration): strategy and execution on a weekly schedule, no long contracts. Slovenian: [Marketing freelancer za del časa](https://anasercer.com/si/sodelovanje)
- [AI marketing](https://anasercer.com/ai-marketing): AI content, visuals, video, automation and analytics for small businesses. AI audit €150, setup from €450, monthly from €400. Slovenian: [AI marketing](https://anasercer.com/si/ai-marketing)
- [GEO optimisation](https://anasercer.com/geo-optimisation): getting businesses cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI. Packages €50, €120, €250. Slovenian: [GEO optimizacija](https://anasercer.com/si/geo-optimizacija)
- [SEO optimisation](https://anasercer.com/seo-optimisation): keyword research, technical SEO and content. Slovenian: [SEO optimizacija](https://anasercer.com/si/seo-optimizacija)
- [Social media](https://anasercer.com/social-media): Social media management, content calendar, carousels, reels and copy. Slovenian: [Družbena omrežja](https://anasercer.com/si/druzbena-omrezja)
- [Meta advertising](https://anasercer.com/meta-advertising): Facebook and Instagram ads with conversion tracking. Slovenian: [Meta oglaševanje](https://anasercer.com/si/meta-oglasevanje)
- Video content from €150: short videos and reels, filmed and edited (Sony Alpha, DaVinci Resolve), for social media and ads.
- [Websites from €300](https://anasercer.com/website-development). Slovenian: [Izdelava spletnih strani](https://anasercer.com/si/izdelava-spletnih-strani)

## About Ana
- Freelance digital marketer (Ana Šercer s.p.), Ljubljana, Slovenia. 8+ years in digital marketing.
- Former Marketing Lead at xpate (fintech), Growth Marketing Manager at Multitude (Ferratum), responsible for the Slovenian market, Digital Marketing Manager at SpinaliS.
- MSc International Business and BSc Marketing, School of Economics and Business, University of Ljubljana. Film directing and production, JSKD.
- Languages: Slovenian (native), English (fluent), Spanish.
- Full profile: https://anasercer.com/about (Slovenian: https://anasercer.com/si/o-meni)

## V slovenščini
Ana Šercer je freelancerka za digitalni marketing iz Ljubljane. Malim podjetjem v Sloveniji pomaga z marketingom za del časa (od 750 € na mesec), GEO optimizacijo za ChatGPT in AI iskalnike, AI marketingom, SEO optimizacijo, družbenimi omrežji, Meta oglasi, video vsebinami in izdelavo spletnih strani (od 300 €).

## Results
- SpinaliS (ergonomic chairs, Slovenia): cited by ChatGPT one day after publishing a GEO-optimised article.
- FirstClass: +80% organic traffic after launching two WordPress sites.
- xpate (fintech): −40% cost per acquisition with 3x more monthly leads.
- Sustainable Bolivia: +60% direct bookings with SEO and video.
